lines.en: : Wow, Aki-kun. You look super drained all of a sudden. Want to rest your head on my shoulder?
lines.zh: : 哇，Aki 君。你突然看起来累坏了。要不要把头靠在我肩膀上歇会儿？

lines.en: : He’s probably just exhausted from all the sex you made him have with Makoto.
lines.zh: : 他大概只是被你逼着跟 Makoto 做了那么多次，给累坏了而已。
: Ami，嘘！

lines.en: : How many times do I have to warn you to not talk about that when there are others around? Daddy could get into a lot of trouble if people find out he’s conducting socially unacceptable acts with your friends.
lines.zh: : 我到底要警告你多少次，别人在的时候别提那件事？要是被人发现爸爸在跟你的朋友们做社会所不容的事，他可是会惹上大麻烦的。

lines.en: : But when is he going to conduct socially unaccepetable acts with me?! I’m tired of just watching!
lines.zh: : 可他什么时候才跟我做社会所不容的事啊？！我已经看腻了！

lines.en: : He just loves you way too much to do that kind of stuff with you, my little lightning bug.
lines.zh: : 他就是太爱你了，才不肯跟你做那种事，我的小萤火虫。

lines.en: : But he loves you too and you get to do it all the time...
lines.zh: : 可他也爱你啊，而你随时都能跟他做……

lines.en: : That’s because he loves me romantically. And also because he has built an unbreakable dependency on my body over our long, joyous life together.
lines.zh: : 那是因为他爱我，是恋人之间的爱。还有，在我们漫长而快乐的生活里，他已经对我的身体产生了无法戒断的依赖。

lines.en: : Fine...But I am not happy about this.
lines.zh: : 好吧……但我不高兴。

lines.en: : I guess you get to join your father then since he seems dead set on sulking for the rest of the night.
lines.zh: : 那看来你只能跟你爸爸一起闷着了，因为他似乎打定主意要闹一整晚的别扭。

lines.en: : Aki-kuuuuuun! It’s time to eat your dinner~
lines.zh: : Aki 君——！该吃晚饭啦～

lines.en: : Or perhaps you’d like another helping of me instead?
lines.zh: : 还是说，你想再来一份“我”？

lines.en: : You haven’t seen Makoto ever since that...thing happened, have you?
lines.zh: : 自从那件……事发生之后，你就再没见过 Makoto 了吧？

lines.en: : No. But we don’t have to use her again. If you really want a second girl, Rin looks cute today. Want me to go work my magic for you and get her pants off?
lines.zh: : 没有。但我们不必再拿她用了。如果你真的想要第二个女孩，Rin 今天看起来挺可爱的。要不要我去施展一下魔法，把她的裤子脱下来？

lines.en: : I’m not talking about sex. I was just kind of mean to her and I feel like I should probably apologize.
lines.zh: : 我说的不是那种事。我只是对她有点过分，觉得应该去道个歉。

lines.en: : For what? She loves being talked down to. You saw firsthand how into it she got when I was flexing on her back in the sex room.
lines.zh: : 道什么歉？她就喜欢被人居高临下地说。你在性爱室里亲眼看见了，我在她背上摆弄的时候她有多来劲。

lines.en: : Mom, maybe we should leave Daddy alone for a few minutes? The doctor says we’re not supposed to press him when he gets like this.
lines.zh: : 妈妈，也许我们该让爸爸一个人待几分钟？医生说过，他变成这样的时候我们不该逼他。
: 我幸福过吗？

lines.en: : Probably not if there’s some kind of “doctor” involved.
lines.zh: : 既然还牵扯到什么“医生”，那大概不算幸福。

lines.en: : I just wanted to know if I turned out okay with a life like this. A wife. A daughter. A job. And presumably still an unhealthy amount of sex with teenage girls.
lines.zh: : 我只是想知道，过上这样的日子，我是不是也算过得不错。一个妻子。一个女儿。一份工作。大概还少不了跟未成年少女做那些不太健康的性事。

lines.en: : Define “unhealthy” because I actually think all of that exercise is the main reason you’re still in shape.
lines.zh: : 先定义一下“不健康”，因为说实话，我觉得正是那些运动让你到现在还保持得这么好。

lines.en: : You seem happy to me, Dad. At least most of the time.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你看起来很幸福啊，爸爸。至少大部分时候是。

lines.en: : Sometimes...it feels like there’s nothing I can do for you, though. And even if I know now that some brains are just built like that, it still makes me sad seeing you that way.
lines.zh: : 不过有时候……会觉得我什么都帮不了你。就算我现在知道有些人的脑子天生就是那样的，看你那个样子，我还是会难过。
: 说得好，Ami。

lines.en: : Let me ask you this, Akira — do you see this beautiful girl we made? Do you really think you could ever be unhappy with her by your side?
lines.zh: : 我问你，Akira——你看见我们造出的这个漂亮女孩了吗？有她在身边，你真觉得自己还会不幸福吗？

lines.en: : Even if you’re a time-traveler who comes from a world where I’m dead, Ami’s still there, isnt she? And there’s no way she would ever fall out of love with you.
lines.zh: : 就算你是个来自我已经死去的世界的时间旅行者，Ami 不也还在吗？而且她绝不可能不再爱你。

lines.en: : So it doesn’t matter whether or not I stick around when I’ve given you the best gift a woman can give no matter what timeline you come from.
lines.zh: : 所以，无论你来自哪条时间线，我都给了你一个女人能给的最好的礼物，那我留不留下也就不重要了。

lines.en: : Unless there’s some bonus timeline I don’t know about where I’m born infertile and am thus incapable of harboring any children. If there’s a world like that where I’m also dead, that probably sucks for you.
lines.zh: : 除非还有一条我不知道的附加时间线，我在那儿天生不孕，没法怀上任何孩子。如果真有那么一个世界，而我在那儿也死了，那对你来说大概挺惨的。

lines.en: : But also probably not because then you could do it inside as many times as you want and I’d never get pregnant!
lines.zh: : 不过大概也不算惨，因为那样你就可以想射多少就射多少在里面，而我又永远不会怀孕！

lines.en: : Awww...But that would mean you could do it inside as many times as you want and I’d never get pregnant...
lines.zh: : 呜呜……可那样就意味着你可以想射多少就射多少在里面，而我又永远不会怀孕……

lines.en: : I’m surprised you two haven’t made me a sister yet if that’s your outlook on sex.
lines.zh: : 既然你们对性事是这种看法，我倒是挺意外你们到现在还没给我添个妹妹。

lines.en: : Do you really want one? Because I’m totally not into the idea of popping another kid out. But if my little girl is feeling lonely, I’ll certainly think about it.
lines.zh: : 你真的想要吗？我可是一点都不想再生一个出来。不过如果我的小宝贝觉得孤单，我当然可以考虑考虑。

lines.en: : Hm? Oh, no. I’m fine with being an only child. I have you two to keep me company, and then Ayane and Sana when neither of you are around. I was just poking a little fun at you.
lines.zh: : 嗯？哦，不。我当独生女挺好的。有你们俩陪我，你们都不在的时候还有 Ayane 和 Sana。我只是逗你玩而已。

lines.en: : Oh, you little kidder, you! No more joking about siblings, though. It’s a sore spot for your father.
lines.zh: : 哦，你这小滑头！不过别再拿兄弟姐妹开玩笑了。那是你爸爸的痛处。

lines.en: : Hahaheheh! Mom, stop it! You’re gonna embarrass me in front of all of my friends!
lines.zh: : 哈哈嘿嘿！妈妈，别这样！你会让我在我所有朋友面前丢脸的！

lines.en: : Oooooh? Well, if booping you is too embarrassing...looks like I’ll just have to tickle you instead! Come here, lightning bug!
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦？既然戳你太让你难为情……看来我只好改成挠你痒痒了！过来，小萤火虫！

lines.en: : AhahahAahHahahah! Stop it! Oh my god! Aaaaaah! Moooooom!
lines.zh: : 啊哈哈哈啊哈哈哈！别闹了！天啊！啊啊啊！妈——妈！
也许我就留在这儿吧。

lines.en: Maybe I can trick myself into believing this isn’t temporary when I knew within the first few minutes it would be.
lines.zh: 也许我还能骗自己相信这一切不是暂时的——尽管刚来的头几分钟我就知道它是。

lines.en: What’s that? You want to know how I knew? Easy. One of my wishes came true. In fact, several of my wishes came true.
lines.zh: 什么？你想知道我是怎么知道的？很简单。我的一个愿望成真了。事实上，我的好几个愿望都成真了。

lines.en: But even though I can be immersed in them here in a manner far different from what I see and feel on that bed in an endless ocean, it’s exactly like you’d expect.
lines.zh: 尽管在这里我能以截然不同的方式沉浸其中，与那片无尽海洋里的床上所见所感完全不同，但结果正如你所料。
好得不像真的。

lines.en: Apart from the fact that Maya doesn’t exist here, but...in a depressing and hard-to-admit way, that’s good too.
lines.zh: 除了 Maya 在这个世界并不存在这一点——不过……以一种令人沮丧又难以启齿的方式，这也是好事。

lines.en: It makes all of her suffering for nothing, sure. But...
lines.zh: 这确实让她受过的苦都白费了，没错。可是……

lines.en: I think she’d choose that over endless torment without any hesitation at all.
lines.zh: 我想她会毫不犹豫地选择这个，而不是无尽的折磨。
我知道我会。

lines.en: And even if moments like this make it feel worth it, the amount of time I’ll be able to drown myself in that feeling is but one tick of the second-hand on a clock with infinite hours.
lines.zh: 即便这样的瞬间让它显得值得，我能沉溺于这种感觉的时间，也不过是那只拥有无限小时的钟表上秒针走过的一格。

lines.en: : You really want me to stay, Sekai?
lines.zh: : 你真的希望我留下来吗，Sekai？

lines.en: : Hm? Stay where? What are you talking about, Dad?
lines.zh: : 嗯？留在哪儿？你在说什么呀，爸爸？

lines.en: : Something he and I were discussing earlier, Ami. You don’t need to worry about it. And yes, Aki-kun. I do.
lines.zh: : 是我和他之前聊过的事，Ami。你不用担心。是的，Aki 君。我真的希望。

lines.en: : But why? Don’t you feel guilty at all about just casting aside the me you’ve been with this entire time?
lines.zh: : 可为什么？你就一点都不觉得愧疚吗——就这么把一直陪着你的那个我抛到一边？

lines.en: : Why would I feel guilty about that? They’re all you.
lines.zh: : 我为什么要为此愧疚？他们全都是你啊。

lines.en: : You look the same and smell the same. You feel the same things. And yeah, memories are nice to have, but they aren’t everything, Aki-kun. My love isn’t tied to something silly like that.
lines.zh: : 你长得一样，闻起来一样。感受到的东西也一样。是啊，有回忆是好事，但回忆不是一切，Aki 君。我的爱不会绑在那种愚蠢的东西上。

lines.en: : I love you because you’re you. And because you love me. It’s that simple. And all you’re going to do by questioning that is break yourself down.
lines.zh: : 我爱你，因为你是你。也因为你爱我。就这么简单。你一味追问下去，只会把自己一点点拆碎。

lines.en: : It’s not your fault you were sent somewhere you aren’t meant to be. So why should you be punished for that when this you loves me just as much as the old one?
lines.zh: : 被送到一个你本不该在的地方，不是你的错。那么这个你也一样爱我，为什么你要为此受罚呢？

lines.en: : Of course I want you to stay. I’ll take you no matter which you it is, because I know you’d do the same for me.
lines.zh: : 我当然想让你留下。不管你是哪一个，我都要，因为我知道你也会为我做同样的事。

lines.en: : The main difference is that you’re stubborn, though. So it might just take you a little while to accept it.
lines.zh: : 唯一的区别是你很固执。所以你可能得花点时间才能接受。

lines.en: : I’m really confused by whatever’s going on right now, but I’m with Mom. It doesn’t matter when or where you’re from — just who you are. And all it takes is one look at you to know you’re the same Daddy I’ve always had.
lines.zh: : 我现在完全搞不懂发生了什么，但我站妈妈这边。你来自何时何地都不重要——重要的是你是谁。只要看你一眼就知道，你一直都是我的那个爸爸。

lines.en: : Now, is there anything else I can say to mend your blistered heart? Any additional compliments you’re craving or reassurance needed so you can trick yourself into believing that someone out there accepts you?
lines.zh: : 那么，我还能再说点什么来修补你那颗起泡的心吗？还想听什么赞美，或者需要什么保证，好让你骗自己相信这世上有人接纳了你？

lines.en: : Can you reassure me that this is real and that it’s not going to just be taken away from me out of nowhere again?
lines.zh: : 你能不能向我保证，这一切是真的，不会再毫无征兆地被从我身边夺走？

lines.en: : Because it might sound a little corny, but losing you again is going to hurt just as much as the first time.
lines.zh: : 因为这话听着可能有点肉麻，可再一次失去你，会跟第一次一样痛。

lines.en: : Well, that’s not true at all. Nothing will ever measure up to that first time. You know that. And in terms of assuring you that this is real? Whoo boy. Don’t even get me started.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这可完全不对。什么都比不上第一次。你心里清楚。至于要我向你保证这是真的？哎呀，那可别让我开这个头。
: 哎呀……又来了……

lines.en: : To answer that question — we must first define what “real” is. For, you see-
lines.zh: : 要回答这个问题——我们必须先定义什么是“真实”。因为，你看——

lines.en: : Time is just a construct. Perception shapes the world around us. There is no way to prove the existence of God or the idea that life itself is or is not a simulation. Blah, blah, blah. Let’s eat.
lines.zh: : 时间不过是一种建构。感知塑造我们周围的世界。无法证明神的存在，也无法证明生命本身是不是一场模拟。吧啦吧啦吧啦。吃饭吧。

lines.en: : Noooooo! You totally paraphrased my philosophical rant! And made it way less interesting in the process! Now Aki-kun is going to come up with his own ideas and probably get sent to a different afterlife!
lines.zh: : 不——！你把我的哲学长篇大论给整个概括掉了！而且讲得无聊透顶！这下 Aki 君要自己琢磨出一套想法，说不定会被送到别的来世去！

lines.en: : Do you even believe in an afterlife, Mom? I thought you said the other day that you weren’t sure?
lines.zh: : 妈妈你到底信不信有来世啊？我记得你前几天还说你不确定？

lines.en: : I’m not. That was just a joke. Which you have also now ruined by forcing me to address it. Bad, Ami. Go to the sex room and repent.
lines.zh: : 我是不信。那只是个玩笑。现在你还逼我解释，把它也给毁了。不乖，Ami。去性爱室反省。

lines.en: : Only if I can take Daddy there.
lines.zh: : 除非让我带上爸爸一起去。

lines.en: : Ready to screw your daughter, big guy?
lines.zh: : 准备好了吗，大家伙，要来操你女儿了？
: 拜托嘛？

lines.en: : Definitely not in this timeline...In the event that I’m gone soon, I want to leave things as perfect as they were when I got here.
lines.zh: : 在这条时间线上绝对不行……万一我很快就要消失了，我想把一切都留在我刚来时那样完美。

lines.en: : Well, I hope you’ve got at least one more round in you, dearest husband.
lines.zh: : 那我只能希望你还剩至少一发的力气了，亲爱的老公。

lines.en: : Because one of my students is on her way here as we speak. And she sounded like she really wanted it today if you know what I’m saying.
lines.zh: : 因为我的一个学生这会儿正往这儿来呢。听她的口气，今天可是相当想要——你懂我意思吧。
: 所以你……也还在教书？

lines.en: : Oh, right. This Aki-kun wouldn’t know. I’m an English teacher at Kumon-mi Academy and-
lines.zh: : 哦，对。这位 Aki 君还不知道。我是 Kumon-mi 学园的英语老师，而且——

lines.en: : Oh, look! There she is now!
lines.zh: : 哦，快看！她来了！

lines.en: : Nodoka! We’re over here! Come sit! This roast is to die for!
lines.zh: : Nodoka！我们在这儿！过来坐！这烤肉好吃得要命！

lines.en: : You’re going to love this girl, Aki-kun. She’s not only a genius, but a total freak. Like, I’m talking Lovecraftian-
lines.zh: : 你会喜欢这女孩的，Aki 君。她不只是个天才，还是个十足的怪胎。我是说，洛夫克拉夫特级别的那种——
: 我已经认识她了……

lines.en: : Nodoka?! What are you doing here?! If I had known you were coming, I would have-
lines.zh: : Nodoka？！你怎么会在这儿？！早知道你要来，我就——
: 我得完成……
: 给我的孩子起名……

lines.en: : Damn. She’s even weirder than you made her sound, Futaba. And that’s saying a lot since you made her sound really fucking weird.
lines.zh: : 靠。她比你形容的还怪，Futaba。而你这话分量可不轻，毕竟你把她形容得已经他妈的够怪了。
: 是啊……她有时候就那样。

lines.en: : Wait- how do you two know each other, Aki-kun? Nodoka’s never even mentioned you-
lines.zh: : 等等——你们俩怎么认识的，Aki 君？Nodoka 可从没提过你——
: 在我的世界里……不是这个世界……

lines.en: : Oooooh. Yeah, that makes more sense then. Boo! There goes the surprise...
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦。是啊，那这就说得通了。啧！惊喜就这么没了……
: 你是哪一个？……
: 我已经再也分不清了……

lines.en: : Did you...come here at the same time as me?...
lines.zh: : 你是……跟我同时来到这儿的吗？……
: 我不……
: 我想不起来……
: 到底过了多久……

lines.en: : Then...how am I supposed to prove who I am?...
lines.zh: : 那……我该怎么证明我是谁？……
: 你能不能……
: 问我关于鸟的事？……
: 你知道些什么……
: 关于白额鹦鹉？
: 我失败了……
: 失败什么？……
: 一切……
: Nodoka——
: 求你了……

lines.en: : May I hold you for just a moment?...
lines.zh: : 能让我抱你一小会儿吗？……

lines.en: : I never did this back home.
lines.zh: : 在家的时候我从没这样做过。
: 我为什么会这样呢？……
: 你要不要……
: 想出去走走？……
: 没有意义。
: 这一切都没有意义。
: 我想不明白。
: 但我现在知道了，Akira……
: 她没有疯。
: 她只是害怕。
: 你也害怕吗？……
: 因为我曾经害怕过……
: 但我现在不怕了。
: 那颜色……
: 又出现了……

lines.en: : And more beautiful than ever before...
lines.zh: : 而且比以往任何时候都美……

lines.en: : Oooookay. This is officially weird now.
lines.zh: : 好——吧。这下是真的怪了。

lines.en: : I need you to listen to three things.
lines.zh: : 我需要你记住三件事。

lines.en: : First, stay away from the roof of the school. And do not, under any circumstances, attempt to leave Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: : 第一，远离学校的天台。而且无论如何都不要试图离开 Kumon-mi。

lines.en: : Second, do not let me continue my research. You must convince me to stop. But it will not be easy. You’ll likely have to force me. But that’s okay. I’ll only pretend to dislike it.
lines.zh: : 第二，别让我继续我的研究。你必须说服我停下来。但这并不容易。你可能不得不强迫我。不过没关系，我只会装作不高兴。
: 第三……

lines.en: : You’re going to need a new shirt.
lines.zh: : 你需要一件新衬衫。
: 什么？
: 嗯？Ami？是不是——
: Nodoka？……

lines.en: : Ami, no! What are you doing?! Stop!
lines.zh: : Ami，不要！你在干什么？！住手！
: 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！！

lines.en: : Yo, what the fuck?! Everybody, book it! Chika, come on!
lines.zh: : 喂，搞什么鬼？！大家快跑！Chika，跟上！

lines.en: : Holy shit! Rin! Futaba! What are you waiting for?! We’ve gotta get out of here! I’ll call an-
lines.zh: : 我操！Rin！Futaba！你们还等什么？！我们得赶紧离开这儿！我去叫——

lines.en: : Molly’s still not here! And Futaba won’t move! I-I-I-I don’t know what to do!
lines.zh: : Molly 还没来！Futaba 又不肯动！我我我我不知道该怎么办！

lines.en: : I’ll find them! Miku, call an ambulance!
lines.zh: : 我去找她们！Miku，叫救护车！
: 啊啊啊啊……

lines.en: : Aaaah, fuck! Okay! Nevermind! Come with me! Everybody outside! Tsuneyo and Molly, if you’re listening, don’t come out!
lines.zh: : 啊，操！行吧！当我没说！跟我来！所有人出去！Tsuneyo、Molly，如果你们听见了，别出来！
: Ami……为什么？……
: 为什么？……
: 她没被邀请。
: 你……在……毁掉……万圣节！！！没……人……想让你……在这儿！！！

lines.en: : Ami, please stop! Why are you doing this?! That poor girl did nothing wrong! She’s only here to see me!
lines.zh: : Ami，求你住手！你为什么要这么做？！那可怜的女孩什么都没做错！她只是来看我的！

lines.en: : Akira, do something! I don’t want to get blood on my dress!
lines.zh: : Akira，做点什么啊！我可不想让血溅到我的裙子上！

lines.en: : YOU THINK...YOU’RE SO SMART...WITH YOUR...PARROTS AND...BOOKS!
lines.zh: : 你以为……你多了不起……有你的……鹦鹉和……书！
: 那现在谁才聪明，贱货？！
: 滚……出……我的……幸福……结局！

lines.en: : Ami...there’s no coming back from this...
lines.zh: : Ami……这事已经无法挽回了……

lines.en: : They’re going to take you away from us now...
lines.zh: : 他们会把你从我们身边带走的……
: 我哪儿都不会去……

lines.en: : This will all be over soon...
lines.zh: : 这一切很快就会结束的……

lines.en: : And then we’ll do it again...
lines.zh: : 然后我们会再来一次……
: 再一次！

lines.en: : AND AGAIN AND AGAIN AND AGAIN AND AGAIN UNTIL WE GET THE WORLD WE WANT!
lines.zh: : 再一次再一次再一次，直到我们得到想要的世界！

lines.en: : EVERYTHING...WAS PERFECT HERE...UNTIL YOU WENT AND FUCKING RUINED IT!!!
lines.zh: : 这里的一切……都曾完美无缺……直到你去他妈的把它毁了！！！

lines.en: : AND NOW MY DADDY HAS TO WATCH ME BE A BAD GIRL ALL BECAUSE OF YOU!
lines.zh: : 而现在，我爸爸不得不看着我当个坏女孩，全都因为你！

lines.en: : ARE YOU HAPPY NOW?! IS THIS WHAT YOU WANTED?!
lines.zh: : 你现在满意了吗？！这就是你想要的？！

lines.en: : WHAT’D YOU WHISPER TO HIM, HUH? WHAT’D YOU SAY?! SPIT IT OUT, BITCH!
lines.zh: : 你跟他耳语了什么，嗯？你说了什么？！说啊，贱人！
: Ami……求你了……
: 她已经没气了。
: 啊啊啊……已经没了吗？

lines.en: : But that was so quick. She didn’t even struggle.
lines.zh: : 可这也太快了。她连挣扎都没挣扎。

lines.en: : How could she?! You stabbed her in the back and then immediately hollowed out a hole in her abdomen!
lines.zh: : 她怎么挣扎？！你从背后捅了她一刀，紧接着就在她肚子上挖了个洞！
: 我知道！很酷吧？

lines.en: : No, Ami! Not cool! You’re being a very bad girl! Murder is strictly off-limits. You are hereby grounded if you are not in jail by the end of the night.
lines.zh: : 不，Ami！一点都不酷！你现在是个非常坏的女孩！杀人绝对是禁区。如果今晚结束前你没进监狱，那我就正式禁你的足。

lines.en: : But I did it for us, Mommy. She was trying to keep us apart.
lines.zh: : 可我是为了我们才这么做的，妈妈。她想把我们拆散。

lines.en: : We get to stay together now. Just you, me, and Daddy for the rest of our lives. And then other lives. Until the egg has finally cracked and there are no more lives to live.
lines.zh: : 现在我们可以永远在一起了。就你、我，还有爸爸，共度这一生。然后是下一条命。直到那颗蛋终于裂开，再也没有可活的生命为止。
: 你为我骄傲，对吧？
: 我做得很好吧？
: 我做得很好，不是吗？

lines.en: : Come on, dear. Let’s get you cleaned up.
lines.zh: : 来吧，亲爱的。我们去把你弄干净。

lines.en: : Sorry, Akira. We’ll be right back. Can you drag the body over...somewhere, please? Dead things creep me out. Like ew, look at her face. It’s all pale and...not pretty now.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Akira。我们马上回来。你能不能把尸体拖到……别的地方去？死掉的东西让我发毛。哎呀，你看她那张脸。全白了，而且……现在一点也不好看了。
: Aki 君——？喂？

lines.en: : Blech. I got some of her blood in my mouth.
lines.zh: : 呕。我嘴里溅到她的血了。

lines.en: : Yeah, it’s all over your face too. Just look at- boop!
lines.zh: : 是啊，你脸上也都是。你看——啵！

lines.en: : Aaah! Mooooom! Stop booping me in front of Dad!
lines.zh: : 啊啊！妈——妈！别在爸爸面前戳我！
Ami 的好感度提升至 [ami_love]！
